label: 4 · Tag Navigation
info:
Tag-to-tag navigation as a flow.

ONE generic command node ('DEXI command → request' + 'DEXI services') talks to both on-board services; the mission is a list of steps inside the 'mission' function node. Start it from the RC hand-off (channel 7 to Offboard), from the ENGAGE button here, or START for bench/sim use.

Sequence on the aircraft: ARM hand-off once after deploy → pilot takes off and hovers over any tag → pilot flips Offboard → tag_nav reports engaged → mission runs → lands. Leaving Offboard stands the mission down.

label: 5 · AVR 2026
info:
The drone runs a YOLO model trained on the AVR 2026 field artwork and
publishes what it sees on `/yolo_detections`. Turn those detections into the
right LED color.

The subscribe and service-call nodes are wired. `gasoline` is done as an
example. The other nine are yours.

1. Point the camera at a printed card and watch the `raw detections` debug
   node to see the data.
2. Read the `pick a class` function node. It works but it is basic.
3. Add rules to the `class -> color` switch node.

name: Class labels
info:
The ten strings the model can emit. Copy and paste them, a typo will not
raise an error.

```
wheat_barrel
water_barrel
gasoline
toxic_fluid
wheat_barn
water_barn
bridge_1line
bridge_2line
bridge_3line
blackout
```

The color for each one is in the AVR 2026 game manual.

name: pick a class
Add the other classes
info:
`gasoline` goes out of output 1 to a red `led` node.

Add a rule per class, set the switch to that many outputs, and wire each one
to an `led` node with the right color. Check the manual for how many colors
you need.

name: Already wired
info:
`led` turns a color name into a service request and `ros2-service-call`
sends it. Every `led` node wires into this same service call node.

Colors: red green blue yellow purple cyan white orange teal magenta gold
pink aqua jade amber old_lace black. black turns the ring off.

name: Turning the ring off when detection stops
info:
The detector publishes only when it sees something, so nothing arrives on
an empty frame and the ring would hold its last color indefinitely.

Every detection restarts the timer below. When 5 seconds pass with no
detection the timer fires and the ring goes off.

The ring is shared with the flight mode indicator, which sets a color only
when the mode changes. After this clears the ring, the flight mode color
returns on the next mode change.
